# Data Transform

A TYPED skill with governance decorators in the handler.
Reads structured data, validates schema, transforms to target format,
and writes output files.

## Capabilities

- Read structured data files (JSON, CSV)
- Validate against schema definitions
- Transform data between formats
- Write output to workspace
